News.title: Body found in woodland during search for teenage boy, 17, who vanished after getting into Uber
News.content:
Add us as a preferred source

TRAGIC END Body found in woodland during search for teenage boy, 17, who vanished after getting into Uber

A BODY has been found in the search for a missing teenager who was last seen getting into an Uber.

Cops searching for Mason Pinsent, 17, found a body in woodland as they desperately hunted for the youngster.

The discovery was made off Crownhill Road in Plymouth yesterday, with detectives and forensic officers pictured at the scene.

Mason was reported missing on Wednesday evening, sparking an urgent search after concerns grew for his welfare.





He had last been seen getting into an Uber in the Stoke area of Plymouth.

He was then driven to an unknown destination, with cops believing he remained in the city.

But the search ended in tragedy when officers discovered a body in woodland the following day.

Formal identification has yet to take place, but Mason’s family have been told of the devastating discovery.



Devon and Cornwall Police said: “We are saddened to confirm that a body has been found in the search for a missing 17-year-old from Plymouth.

“While formal identification has yet to take place, the family of missing teenager Mason Pinsent has been informed.

“Our thoughts are with them at this incredibly difficult time.

“The death is not being treated as suspicious, and a file will be prepared for HM Coroner.”

News.content:

TRAIN HORROR Woman ‘sexually assaulted on crowded train’ as cops release CCTV

COPS have released images of a man they want to speak to after a woman was sexually assaulted on a busy train.

The alleged attack happened on an Elizabeth Line train as it travelled through London on Sunday, April 19.

The victim was targeted with the suspect allegedly trying to hide his actions among other passengers.

The man boarded the train at Tottenham Court Road at around 7.30pm.





When the train arrived at Bond Street, he allegedly sexually assaulted a woman.

He is said to have then got off the train at Ealing Broadway.

British Transport Police detectives have now released new images of a man they believe could have information which may help their investigation.

Officers are urging anyone who recognises him to come forward.

A BTP spokesperson said: “Detectives continuing to investigate a sexual assault on board an Elizabeth Line train are today releasing new images in connection.”

Anyone with information is asked to text British Transport Police and quote reference 115 of 20 April.
